rule: A unit is the emulated activity of its family's documented procedure if at least one of its processes runs a tool that procedure names (process image basename, case-insensitive) and that is not in generic_hosts. Every other unit is declared excluded with the reason recorded. Labels are never taken from the engine's detections.

v2-apt3-caldera.deferred: Every unit runs only through generic hosts (the CALDERA PowerShell agent, cmd.exe); identifying the agent would require matching command-line content against the procedure, which this corpus step does not do. Deferred, not guessed.

v2-lsass-01-logonpasswords.deferred: The documented tool (Mimikatz logonpasswords) runs in memory of generic hosts; no unit runs a named, non-generic tool.

v2-lsass-03-comsvcs.deferred: The documented technique (comsvcs.dll MiniDump) runs through rundll32.exe, a generic host.

v2-lsass-04-out-minidump.deferred: The campaign metadata names no non-generic tool (Out-Minidump.ps1 runs in PowerShell).
